scopeNote: integration contract: Pure-Swift client (PyricFunctions) conforming to FirebaseFunctions via the Pyric Functions HTTP gateway and WebSocket bridge. Covers Functions per-app/region/customDomain singletons, useEmulator, untyped HTTPSCallable and generic Codable Callable<Request, Response> with callAsFunction and completion handlers, cloudfunctions.net and Cloud Run URL rewriting with off-machine refusal, 64-bit Int64Value/UInt64Value serialization, Auth Bearer and standard or limited-use X-Firebase-AppCheck header propagation, AsyncThrowingStream<StreamResponse> SSE streaming, FunctionsError/NSError bridging, and timeoutInterval deadlines.
